JK SET 2024 - Exam Dates, Latest News, Application Form, Eligibility, Admit Card, Result Candidates who have secured at least 55% marks (General Category) and 50% marks (Reserved categories) in Master’s Degree or equivalent examination from universities/institutions recognized by UGC in Sciences, Humanities (including languages) and Social Science are eligible to apply for the JK SET.
